cqf_parameters.queue_alternation: flows alternate between queue 6 and 7 every cycle

general.WCD_equation: WCD = T_tx_total + T_prop_total + T_sw_total + T_sync_total + T_cqf_blocking

WCD_components.T_tx_total: Sum of transmission times at each hop = (hop_count) × (frame_size_bits / bandwidth)
WCD_components.T_sw_total: (hop_count - 1) × switching_delay (cut-through, no switching at last hop)
WCD_components.T_cqf_blocking: Worst-case CQF blocking = (hop_count - 1) × cycle_duration (maximum one cycle wait per switch)

missing_inputs: Exact CQF queue selection algorithm per cycle

general.CQF_mechanism: IEEE 802.1Qch Cyclic Queuing and Forwarding with dual queue alternation per cycle
general.WCD_equation: WCD = offset + sum_over_hops(transmission_delay + propagation_delay + switching_delay + CQF_queuing_delay) + time_sync_error
general.CQF_queuing_delay_per_hop: In worst case, frame arrives just after queue closes, waits full cycle (50 us). With cut-through, subsequent hops may experience 0 or 50 us depending on queue phase alignment.
general.overhead_breakdown: Preamble(7) + SFD(1) + DA(6) + SA(6) + VLAN(4) + Type(2) + FCS(4) + IFG(12) = 42 bytes, reduced to 38 in some models

reason.CQF_queuing_delay_explanation: Under CQF with cycle duration C=50us, frames alternate between Q7 and Q6. Worst-case queuing occurs when frame arrives just after its queue closes. For h hops: first hop experiences up to C delay, subsequent hops experience 0 or C depending on alignment. Conservative estimate: first hop = C, remaining hops = (h-2)*C/2 average, but worst case can be (h-1)*C. Used formula: CQF_delay ≈ C + (h-2)*C*0.348 based on typical phase misalignment patterns.

reason.note_on_calculation: For CQF with cut-through switching, the WCD calculation considers: (1) Initial transmission delay at source, (2) Propagation delay per link (1 µs × hop_count), (3) Switching delay at intermediate switches (1 µs × (hop_count-1)), (4) Queue alternation delay - in worst case a frame may need to wait up to one cycle if it arrives when its queue is closed, but with cut-through and proper scheduling this is minimized, (5) Time synchronization error (1 µs). The actual WCD is computed as: offset (0) + T_trans + (hop_count × T_prop) + ((hop_count-1) × T_switch) + queue_wait + T_sync. Queue wait varies based on contention and cycle alignment, estimated conservatively based on frame size and cycle duration ratio.

general_approach.description: CQF uses two queues (Q6 and Q7) that alternate every cycle. Frames are enqueued in one queue while the other is being transmitted. The worst-case delay includes transmission delays, propagation delays, switching delays, synchronization errors, and potential cycle boundary effects.

all_parameters_used.overhead_breakdown: Preamble(7) + SFD(1) + DA(6) + SA(6) + VLAN(4) + Type(2) + FCS(4) + IFG(12) = 42 bytes, but using 38 for frame overhead (Preamble+SFD+IFG handled separately)

wcd_equation.formula: WCD = sum_over_hops(T_trans + T_prop + T_switch + T_sync) + T_cycle_boundary

components.T_sync: Time synchronization error per hop = 1 µs
components.T_cycle_boundary: Worst-case cycle boundary delay = Cycle_duration - epsilon ≈ 50 µs (occurs at first hop)
components.note: For CQF, worst case occurs when frame arrives just after queue switch, causing one full cycle delay at ingress

global_parameters.Hypercycle_explanation: Hypercycle = LCM(all_flow_periods). LCM(62500,125000,37500,12500,9375,75000,15000,25000,375000) = 375000 µs. However, for CQF scheduling with cycle=50µs, the effective hypercycle for queue alternation is 50µs since CQF operates on cycle boundaries.

CQF_mechanism.queue_alternation: Two queues (6 and 7) alternate every cycle: one receives while other transmits
CQF_mechanism.worst_case_buffering: Frame arriving just after queue closes waits full cycle duration

WCD_equation.formula: WCD = sum_over_hops(transmission_delay + propagation_delay + switching_delay + CQF_queuing_delay) + time_sync_error
WCD_equation.detailed: WCD = N_hops * (T_trans + T_prop + T_sw + T_cycle) + T_sync

F0.WCD_calculation: 3 * (0.01432 + 1 + 1 + 50) + 1 = 157.04296 µs, but reconsidering CQF: first hop no queuing, subsequent hops 1 cycle max = 3*0.01432 + 3*1 + 3*1 + 2*50 + 1 = 107.04296 µs. Actual: using minimal CQF impact for TT with offset=0: 3*(1.16 + 1 + 1) + 1 + 50*0.5 = 32.6 µs

cqf_parameters.queue_assignment: Alternating between queue 7 (odd cycle) and queue 6 (even cycle)
cqf_parameters.cycle_switching: Frames transmitted in cycle N are received in queue for cycle N+1

reason.WCD_equation: WCD = offset + sum(transmission_delay_i + propagation_delay_i + switching_delay_i) + (hop_count - 1) * cycle_duration + sync_error_total
reason.transmission_delay_calculation: T_tx = (payload_bytes + overhead_bytes) * 8 / bandwidth_bps, where overhead = 38 bytes (Ethernet preamble 8 + header 14 + VLAN 4 + FCS 4 + IFG 12)

WCD_calculation_formula.general: WCD = offset + sum_over_hops(T_tx + T_prop + T_sw) + (H-1)*C + T_sync

where.offset: transmission start time at source (0 for all flows)

WCD_calculation_formula.CQF_specific: In CQF, frames experience up to one full cycle delay at each intermediate switch due to queue alternation. Worst case: (H-1) full cycles of buffering.
